steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Phew—thankfully, my skills haven't dulled. Even if a few more of them show up, I can still—
A few phantom figures shimmer into existence, but this time, it isn't Paradeisos or the Underground. Donald's body stiffens for a moment.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Help me... You're the strongest, get us out of here...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Help me... I'm terrified. I can't die now; I've got family. Please, do something...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Wasn't it you who said... with you around, nothing would go wrong?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Hero... Leader...
You notice something's off in his expression, so you pat Donald on the head.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Ahhh!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Huh? Did I zone out again?
You nod.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Haha... The Black Ring's impact is huge, especially since we can't use your shackles right now. We're quite the battered duo, aren't we?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But you being here, it really gives me a sense of security. Thanks for that.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Let's move. Those groups are quicker than expected, and I'm not planning on lagging behind. You're eager to get this over with as well, aren't you?

The Underground shackles keep pushing forward, with every attack sending shockwaves through the High Tower, shaking everyone inside. But Donald clearly senses the Ring's power intensifying, toughening the tower against the Undergrounder's fierce attacks.
It's a must to prevent the Underground from consuming the Black Ring—the fallout would be catastrophic. However, letting the Black Ring grow stronger is just as unacceptable.

It's becoming clear that an increasing number of people in the West District are caught up in the Black Ring, falling prey to the BR-002 Mania, slowly feeding the monstrous growth. On any battlefield, they're just pawns to be stepped on.
He approaches ${PlayerName} and squats down, ready to carry on, but this time ${PlayerName} doesn't make a move.
The enemy is very strong.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: We'll just have to wing it.
You haven't got a shot at winning.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Yeah, I know.
So, why did you come here?
Chasing pipe dreams just like Rustfire, leading yourself down a dead-end path again?
I'm aware you were the first Rustfire leader.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's come up a lot recently. Do I still resemble them? I thought I'd changed a while back.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm sorry, I realize you've suffered greatly, and the same goes for those dear to you. There's not much I can do to make amends, especially since I have my own agenda on this trip.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: But I'll try my hardest to protect you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: At least, I'm dead set on surviving this and I've made a promise—to bring you back to that girl.
While talking, he gets to his feet and picks up his weapon.
Suddenly, a figure emerges in front.
It is a Paradeisos elite, severely tainted. Just as you are figuring out whether it is living, a laser beam streaks your way, swiftly parried by Donald.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName} of the MBCC, it's time to head back. You're needed at Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Speak your mind if you're unhappy, Chief. I've got you covered.
